transientObservation.description: A diagnostic sampled action chips about80ms after a user selection. The app inherits a180ms background-color transition while text color switches immediately. These transient samples fell below4.5:1; final selected-state measurements below wait at least250ms. Candidate styling was not changed.
transientObservation.status: Original reproduced failure retained. Repaired by the scoped preview-only transition rule; see repairVerification for immediate/intermediate/settled B and C measurements.

kind: C-specific rendered contrast and focus evidence from actual app with isolated candidate injection and synthetic Firebase fixture.

states: Settled states after at least250ms following selection
notMeasured: Art colors: artwork is decorative, not task information

method: WCAG relative luminance from browser-computed sRGB colors. Alpha colors are composited through ancestor backgrounds. Every ancestor opacity, filter, mix-blend-mode and background image is recorded. Calculations are considered effective only when all ancestor group opacities equal1, no filters/blending apply, and an opaque solid surface covers underlying background imagery. Border ratios compare meaningful control boundaries to the immediate exterior surface. The native disclosure panel separator is decorative, not a control boundary. Focus is measured while :focus-visible matches, including outline width and offset.

change.scope: Preview only. Selected text, background and border now switch together. Layout, palette tokens, scale, translate and box-shadow feedback are unchanged. No production stylesheet changes.

repairVerification.method: Actual app with synthetic Firebase fixture. Pointer parked outside controls to exclude hover tint. For each action the existing click handler is invoked; browser-computed selected and deselected colors are sampled synchronously in the same evaluation immediately after click, then with scheduled80ms and250ms samples. Actual elapsed times are recorded. Initial controls are measured before changes. Every action is selected at all three viewports. Alpha colors composited through ancestor solid backgrounds; ancestor opacity/filter/blending audited at every sample.
